title: Enable SMB always while using xdrip in companion app mode and dexcom g7 original app
symptom: When using xdrip in companion app mode fetching bg values from dexcom g7 app, AAPS 3.2.0.3 will not allow SMB to be enabled always. The user wants G7 users to be able to use the latest dexcom g7 app including Clarity and still have hCL/fCL possibility in AAPS.
cause: xDrip does not send which sensor the data comes from in companion app mode, so AAPS cannot determine if the data is from a G7 or e.g. a Medtronic sensor. Therefore AAPS cannot enable SMB always for G7 companion mode.
fix: The issue was resolved by using a newer AAPS version; testing on AAPS 3.3.0-dev-d (Build 986125e7e8) showed that SMB/closed loop now works with xDrip companion app.
evidence_quote: I tested it today on AAPS 3.3.0-dev-d (Build 986125e7e8) and now it seems to work! Closed loop possible even with xdrip companion app, nice!
